name: Full AI turn (mocked)
description: Whole AI turns against a local mock provider scripted to be slow to answer, refuse once and be retried, call a tool, stream with a long pause, and be cancelled part way. Measures every stage of a turn, from the call to the reply on screen, including the network and stream behaviour Archivist sees.
initialConditions: Fresh disposable profile, 1280x840 window, Research layout, one chat view. Fixture: seed 13, a Library of 30 synthetic notes (indexed), conversation 'Lab Turn' (4 messages). Provider: the local mock with the script below, the same every run. No API calls.

script.text: The Library holds thirty notes about archive layout, render panels and the harbour of words.
A long reply that the scenario stops part way through, word by word, so cancelling is measured too.

methods.seedChats: fixture: UiLab.seedChats writes the conversations, and with files a synthetic Library it then indexes, to the test profile's database
methods.refreshChats: store-call: ChatStore.refresh (what the app does on start)
methods.selectChat: store-call: ChatStore.selectChat (what picking a conversation in the side panel does)
methods.sendChatMessage: store-call: ChatStore.sendMessage (what the composer's Send does)
